traits.name: Feign Death
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The opossum is reduced below 15 HP Effect The opossum collapses. It is flat-footed and can use actions that require only its mind, but any other action ends the ruse. A successful DC 18 Perception check to Seek or Medicine check to Recall Knowledge is required to determine that the animal is not, in fact, dead.

traits.name: Revived Retaliation
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The opossum is attacked or disturbed by a creature within reach while Feigning Death Effect The opossum Strikes the triggering creature.

traits.name: Grasping Tail
traits.text: A giant opossum can drag a Small or Tiny creature it has grabbed with its tail along with it when it Strides.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ tail +10 (reach 15 feet); Damage 1d4+4 (1d4+4) bludgeoning plus Grab
